control_profile: Independent long and short funding-unwind sleeves, causal market-state selection, downward volatility scaling, drawdown brakes, close-confirmed loss stop, and one-way turnover cap.
falsifier: Reject if removing forced side symmetry does not create economically meaningful exposure before 2024, if net or double-cost Sharpe remains weak, or if any bull, bear, chop, long, or short role is nonpositive.
formation_horizon: latest settled funding event standardized against forty-two prior events, with three completed price-confirmation bars outside chop
hypothesis: Extreme funding is a crowded basis state whose unwind is tradable after price confirmation, while neutral market states require larger extremes and slower averaging; allowing each side to qualify independently prevents sparse opposite-side events from suppressing the edge.
rebalance_horizon: daily cohorts with three-day confirmed-unwind and seven-day chop-extreme shadow portfolios
